ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 80% high-intensity white and 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone bounded by low-intensity black margins along the trailing edge and terminal tips. A large, irregular black geometric patch originates at the median notch. Small black mottling clusters (mottling) are present in the lower central and inner lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped indentation with an approximate pixel angle of 110 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude variations (2-4 pixels) along the inner trailing edges, transitioning to larger, high-amplitude peaks (8-15 pixels) at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from tips to notch; leading edges exhibit a gentle convex curve toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel patterns localized on the black pigmentation of both the left and right terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, low-intensity linear pixel strings (scratches) detected on the high-intensity white surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization scars represented by high-contrast white circular markings at the terminal edges of the black pigmentation zones.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive jagged 'fringe' transition between black and white pigmentation zones along the left lobe's trailing edge.
